caption: The drawing depicts a large bedroom with walls painted in a light pink color and wooden flooring. At the center-left is a wooden platform bed with a brown mattress, blue and green patterned pillows, and a beige throw blanket. On both sides of the bed are nightstands with white lampshades, books, a telephone, and other small objects. At the foot of the bed is a green bench or table holding various perfume bottles, brushes, bowls, and other small items. A long green wire, possibly from a telephone, extends across the floor. To the right of the bed is an armchair with green cushions and a small side table. In the middle of the room sits a blue coffee table cluttered with papers, boxes, and trinkets. There is an easel near the large windows at the back, along with a standing mirror on a support. The windows are bordered by peach-colored curtains, and potted plants are positioned along the windowsills. To the far right, there is a work desk with a green chair, books, and paper, backed by shelves containing more books and head sculptures. Along the right wall is a dresser or cabinet, with decorative vases and sculptures placed on top. Additional objects, such as trays, notebooks, open boxes, and stationery items, are scattered across the various surfaces throughout the room. The overall composition is detailed and shows a lived-in, functional workspace combined with a sleeping area.
title: Bedroom, 1940
